description_en: Queries the details of a single cloud editing project
description_zh: 查询单个云剪辑工程的信息
name: GetEditingProject

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud editing project
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the request source. Valid values:
OpenAPI: Default. No timeline conversion is performed.
WebSDK: If this field is passed, the project timeline is automatically converted to the frontend style, and the associated media assets in the timeline are bound to the project for preview in the frontend WebSDK
parameters.help_zh:
请求来源标识

-OpenAPI：默认，不会做timeline转换操作。

-WebSDK：若传入该字段，则会自动将工程timeline转换为前端风格，并将timleine中关联素材和工程绑定，供前端websdk预览
parameters.name: request_source

BusinessConfig.description_en: The business configuration of the project. This can be ignored for standard editing projects
BusinessConfig.description_zh: 工程业务配置，一般剪辑工程可忽略

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the project. This can be ignored for standard editing projects. Valid values:
Reserving: Reserving.
ReservationCanceled: Reservation canceled.
BroadCasting: Broadcasting.
LoadingFailed: Loading failed.
LiveFinished: Live streaming finished
BusinessStatus.description_zh:
工程业务状态，一般剪辑工程可忽略

预约中：Reserving

预约取消：ReservationCanceled

直播中：BroadCasting

加载失败：LoadingFailed

直播结束：LiveFinished

ClipsParam.description_en: The media asset parameters corresponding to the template, in JSON format. When TemplateId is not empty, ClipsParam cannot be empty. For the specific format, see [Create and use standard templates]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445399.html） and [Create and use advanced templates]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445389.html）
ClipsParam.description_zh: 模板对应的素材参数，Json格式，当TemplateId不为空时，ClipsParam不能为空。具体格式见 [普通模板创建及使用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445399.html）、[高级模板创建及使用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445389.html）

Description.description_en: The description of the cloud editing project

Duration.description_en: The total duration of the cloud editing project

ModifiedTime.description_en: The last modified time of the cloud editing project. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in UTC (ending with Z)
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 云剪辑工程最新修改时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间（以 Z 结尾）
ModifiedTime.title_en: 云剪辑工程最新修改时间
ModifiedTime.title_zh: 云剪辑工程最新修改时间

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the cloud editing project

ProjectType.description_en:
The type of the editing project. Default value: EditingProject. Valid values:
EditingProject: Standard editing project.
LiveEditingProject: Live editing project
ProjectType.description_zh:
剪辑工程类型，默认EditingProject

- EditingProject: 普通剪辑工程

- LiveEditingProject: 直播剪辑工程

Status.description_en:
The status of the cloud editing project. Valid values:
Draft
Editing
Producing
Produced
ProduceFailed
Deleted
Status.description_zh:
云剪辑工程状态。
所有云剪辑工程状态列表：

-Draft

-Editing

-Producing

-Produced

-ProduceFailed

-Deleted

TemplateType.description_en:
The template type of the cloud editing project. Valid values:
Timeline
VETemplate

Timeline.description_en: The timeline of the cloud editing project

TimelineConvertErrorMessage.description_en: The error message for project conversion failure. This is returned only when TimelineConvertStatus is ConvertFailed and contains detailed information about the conversion failure
TimelineConvertErrorMessage.description_zh: 工程转换失败信息，只有TimelineConvertStatus为ConvertFailed时返回，工程转换的详细失败信息
TimelineConvertErrorMessage.example: The StorageLocation must be in the same division(apiRegion) as ICE service access point.

TimelineConvertStatus.description_en:
The timeline conversion status of the project. Converting an API-style timeline to a frontend-style timeline is an asynchronous process and takes effect only when RequestSource is set to WebSDK. Valid values:
Unconverted: The timeline is not converted.
Converting: The project is being converted.
Converted: The project conversion is completed.
ConvertFailed: The project conversion failed
TimelineConvertStatus.description_zh:
工程转换状态，api风格timeline转换为前端风格timeline是一个异步过程，只有在设置RequestSource:WebSDK时生效。

-Unconverted：未进行Timeline转换

-Converting：工程正在转换中

-Converted：工程转换完成

-ConvertFailed：工程转换失败

Title.description_en: The title of the cloud editing project
